lines.en: I make my way over to the mall to hang out with Chika, but take a wrong turn somewhere and get stuck in an alternate reality instead.
A mysterious creature shows up and immediately scurries away as it may be the first time she’s seen a human being in hundreds of years.
She looks like someone I can’t remember, so I clap my hands to show her I’m not a threat and coax her into returning.
: By any chance...are you...
: Looking for a good time? Sorry lady, but I’m not that kind of guy.
: No! U...Um...What I meant was...are you...by any chance...
: Named...Akira?...
: How do you know my name, mysterious creature?
: Oh my God! It really is you, isn’t it?! It’s been so long!
: Sorry, but...have we met before?
: Only once. You helped rip number 17 out of my mouth after my gums became infected and I’ve been searching for you to say thanks ever since.
: But, as you can see, I haven't really had any success until now.
: God, it's been so long.
: Do you have a name?
: Oh! Right! Silly me.
: I’m Amy.
: Do you...Do you come here often?
: Yeah, but I’m normally on the other side.
: The other side?...
: Do you mean the west wing?
: No, I mean the side where the colors are brighter and there aren’t any character sprites.
: I’m a little confused...but if you’re not familiar with the mall, I wouldn’t mind showing you around!
: No thanks. I’m just gonna head back to where I came from and go hang out with Chika instead. But it was nice seeing you and I’m glad to hear your gums are doing okay.
: But...you can’t leave.
: Why not?
: Because this is a special bonus mission. Nobody is allowed to leave until they’ve had enough fun at the mall. And even then, it's really difficult and there’s no reason to leave in the first place.
: The world outside these walls is contaminated. Breathing in the air for longer than three minutes will fill your lungs with some weird stuff and then you’ll die.
: So, all I have to do is have fun at the mall and I can leave?
: I mean...technically yes. But...did you not just hear the part about how you’ll die?
: Don’t worry. If I die, everything will just start over. It’ll be totally fine.
: Then...in that case, maybe you and me could walk around for a little while?
: You mean like a date?
: You’d really...consider going on a date with someone like me?...
: Do you have any STDs?
: Not any of the bad ones.
: Then sure. I don’t see any harm in that.
: Plus, it’ll help me get acquainted with your side of the mall better. So if you have any tips or recommendations, please let me know.
: I’m very excited to get going!
: Me too! But, be warned — it’s really easy to get lost in there. So easy that even I get lost sometimes, and I’ve been here for thousands of years!
: You look so young for someone in their thousands.
: Teehee! You should have seen me when I still had hands.
: Come on! Let’s get started!
: I’m sure it’ll be a load of fun!
: Hey! Sorry about that. I slipped through a crack in reality and wound up somewhere in Halo 3. But I’m back now!
: Great! Because I have absolutely no idea where we are.
: I already told you, silly! We’re at the mall.
: Before this, you were in the waiting room. That’s the room that you’re supposed to wait in before you’re admitted to the mall.
: Sounds like a pretty serious mall if you need to wait just to get in.
: It’s the most serious mall! Everything you could ever want is here. It’s a little sad though since not many people know about it yet.
: But I’m sure it will be swimming with customers in another year or two! You’ve gotta keep your hopes up, you know?
: So, where should we start?
: Anywhere you want!

: It’d be no fun if I were to just take control of the date, you know? Gender roles dictate that the man is supposed to decide things like this and I’m just supposed to be good and listen to whatever he wants!
: I’m sure any decision you make will be fine! Like I said, everything you could ever want is here. And even if there’s nothing you want, we have that too!

: There’s a hole in the wall of the white room you can throw yourself into that will send you falling for the rest of eternity. That’s where my last boyfriend went, but I didn’t have anything to do with it.
: Cool. Then-
: I promise I didn’t have anything to do with it.
: I didn’t throw him into the hole.
: Okay Amy.
: Seriously, it wasn’t me. He did it himself.
: I didn’t put him in the hole.
: A-Anyway! I’ll shut up about the hole now...
: Just choose a direction and we’ll go from there!
Oh jeez.
I sure hope I don’t get lost.

: Hmm...
: What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
: You’re not lost already, are you?
: Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
: Watch your feet, Akira. The foundation of this hall hasn't fully grown in yet and it’s caused the whole wing to get a little uneven.
: It’s kind of annoying to walk in sometimes, but I bet it would be really fun with a skateboard.
: Do you have a skateboard, Amy?
: Me? I could never. I have a degenerative bone disease and my doctor says extreme sports aren’t good for me. But I do know of a shop here that sells them if you want to try!
: Do you think I’d look cool as a...skateboard person?
: Of course! I think you’ll look cool no matter what you do.
: You've got a bit of a...cool aura to you that's hard to describe.
: Like that feeling you get when you spin around really fast and start to see those white specks everywhere. Just, instead of white specks, it's like...I don't know. Cooler.
: Well, for what it's worth, I think you're pretty cool too. Even with your faulty bones.
: Aww...Thanks, Akira. That means a lot to me.
: I try to keep a positive attitude, but it's hard not getting down on myself sometimes when I look in the mirror, you know?
: Like, I'll think to myself...Amy! No one is ever going to love you and the world would be better off without you in it!
: Wow. That's extremely depressing and very likely untrue.
: Take me, for example. Without you, I'd be totally lost.
: Hahah! Thanks, Akira. It's the same for me whenever I'm not with you.
: Just...a little differently.

: I have no interest in bread, Amy.
: How come? Bread is good for you. The carbohydrates suck away the excess moisture in your intestines and make it so any living creature you accidentally ingest has a harder time moving around.
: Is that a thing you actively worry about?
: Absolutely! If you’ve ever had a tapeworm, you’d understand.
: Thankfully, there have been no recorded cases of anyone contracting tapeworms from Shiawase Group! Or anywhere at the mall!
: So if there’s somewhere you’d like to stop and grab a bite to eat, just let me know. We’ve got a lot more walking ahead of us after all.
: You’re going to need all the energy you can get.

: Wow, this brings back so many memories.
: Are you still in touch with your mom?
: I am! We meet up on Wednesdays to go water the plants and have our retinal fluid refilled over in the medical ward.
: My vision is fine, but hers is starting to get a little worse as the years go by. So I still get the shots myself so she doesn’t have to feel bad about going blind.
: You’re such a good daughter.
: Oh, stop! You’re gonna make me blush...

: Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
: Guh. This part of the mall always creeps me out.
: Why is it so dark?
: Rumor has it that a long time ago, when the mall was first coming into existence, a small group of some...weird kind of entity or something snuck in and started nesting around here.
: I think I heard a thing about how they’d burrow into the ground and then pull the tiles back over the holes they dug to make it look like everything is normal.
: It reminds me a lot of some story my dad read to me when I was little. About these weird monster thingies retreating into the earth to suck up energy from the soil.
: I also heard that if they suck up enough, they can manipulate their bodies into appearing human! Meaning some of them could be here right now and we’d have no idea!
: I’m having second thoughts about exploring this part of the mall now.
: I’m sure it’ll be okay. We have each other, after all!

: I feel...

: That doesn’t sound very legal.
: The craziest part of all of it is that his face has been slowly disappearing day by day. All that’s left now is his right nostril and a tiny skin-gap where his mouth used to be.
: I wonder how he eats?
: I don’t think I want to see the homeless man.
: Are you sure? I have a handful of pennies we can throw at him to make him do a dance.

: I know, I know...But you’re just so cool.
: I’ve always wanted to go on a date with somebody like you. And being able to walk around my favorite place in the world with you like this is...
: Well...
: It makes me really happy.
: So happy that the tiny hairs on my arms are starting to stand up and cut through this shirt I got from the H&M in the north wing.
: So happy that, for the first time in thousands of years, I can feel things...happening to me that haven’t happened in...
: Well, a really long time. And I just don’t want this day to ever come to an end.
: Well, at this rate, you might be in luck. I have no idea where I’m going and feel like I’ve been in here forever.
: The saddest part is that, for me...it only feels like it’s been a few minutes.
: Please stay, Akira.
: We can be happy here.
: If nowhere else will let that happen for us, why not take a chance and...start over now?
: Why not stay in this mall with me for the rest of forever?
: I can’t, Ami.
: Amy. And you can.
: Just save the game.
: Save the game and stay here so the world will stop moving and we can be together forever.
: I know that we’ve only just met, but I feel like I’ve known you forever and...and I can’t let this chance get away!
: Save the game, Akira! Save the game and come visit me every single night! I’ll look forward to it! I’ll never stop looking forward to it!
: And if we run out of things to say, I’ll...I’ll think up new ones! I’ll keep adding new places for us to explore and things to talk about because I...
: I love you.
: And I am finally happy.
: I will always be here.

: You really love this mall, huh?
: It’s the only place where I’ve ever felt like I belong.
: Before I came here, the world I was stuck in was so...
: Well, let’s just say I didn’t really fit in with anybody. And my idea of what a happy life should be was way different from what anyone else thought.
: I’m glad things ended up like this, though. Because even if most of my memories from those days are gone, the ones that are still kinda stuck in my head help me realize that...
: Well, something like this is what’s best for me.
: And having you here only makes that better.
: A-Anyway! Sorry for saying all that embarrassing stuff. We can...
: We can go now. There’s not much else over here.
